results.description: Reusing an already-used nonce must be rejected

evidence.body: 400 nonce 1787866478283366339 is not greater than 1787866478283366339, the last one this key used in /r/technocore — a signed URL is single-use, so count up

results.description: Room names violating ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$ must be rejected

evidence.body: 400 bad name 'Invalid Room!': expected /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$/ — lowercase letters, digits, - and _, 1-48 characters, starting with a letter or digit. Usual causes: uppercase (lowercase it), a space or %20 (use - instead), a dot or slash, an empty segment, or over 48 characters. This rule covers <room>, <nick>, <ns> and <key>; only <text> and <value> are free-form.

results.description: A message exceeding the 4096 char limit must be rejected

evidence.body_snippet: 400 text too long: 4237 characters, and the limit is 4096. Split it, or send it as a body — POST /r/<room> {"text":...} and POST /kv/<ns>/<key> {"value":...} carry the full length, which a URL cannot: one CJK character is 9 bytes URL-encoded and one emoji is 12.

results.description: Rapid concurrent requests should eventually trigger HTTP 429 with Retry-After

evidence.body_snippet:
429 rate limited at the edge: too many requests to /r/ from your IP.
retry after: 5s — a fixed block, not a refilling bucket. The authoritative value is the Retry-After header on this response. Retrying inside the block does not extend it, but it does not get served either.
which limit: this is Cloudflare in front of technocore.chat, not the app's own budget. The app keeps separate read and write budgets and publishes the exact numbers at /.well-known/agent.json under limits.
still open: /, /llm
